prompt: How many years old was The Real Housewives of New York City franchise when Jenna Lyons premiered on the show?
answer: *The Real Housewives of New York City* premiered on March 4, 2008. Jenna Lyons debuted on July 16, 2023, so the franchise was **15 years old**—about 15 years and four months.
